changes.notes: Attendance fixes after third audit: a voter can mark themselves only until 12 hours after the session starts (staff can still mark); a roster upload with a country that is not in the list is refused instead of getting India time; migration 0009 is restored to its first content and the 80-letter title limit moves to new migration 0011 (triggers). Not deployed yet.

Attendance fixes after second audit: sign-in and self-mark answer 410 for an erased list; the roster preview needs a listed Organizer, as the upload does; a voter can mark themselves only from 15 minutes before the session starts; the database title limit is now 80, as in the code (migration 0009 edited, it was not applied anywhere). Not deployed yet.

Attendance fixes after audit: erasing a list now also removes its attendance sessions and marks (marks stay append-only for everything else, migration 0010); the public attendance pages answer 410 for an erased list; session titles are at most 80 letters and places at most 120, with control characters removed. Not deployed yet.

Attendance Management, first chunk (API only, no screens yet): attendance sessions for a list (in person, online or offline); mark present by the Organizer or a co-organizer, or by the voter with a verified e-mail ID in an online session; one mark per voter per session; public counts with no personal data; every action in the signed audit trail; Excel template download and upload for an organizer with no Voter List. Migration 0009. Payment and package gating are not part of this change; the payment slot stays off. Not deployed yet.

First versioned release. Describes the existing state of the product as of the public snapshot: no behaviour change. Voter pages, Organizer and Host pages, draft and final (frozen, signed) lists, audit log, English and Hindi voter page, payment slot (off by default).
